answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 41416 Country: India Title: Zakah on LIC policy. Question: Zaid bought a LIC policy for 20 years and pays Rs.1523/- per month as premium and till now he has deposited total Rs.106266/- as premium. Zaid wants to know is there any zakah wajib on him for the same? Answer ID: 41416 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1689/1326/B=1433) Yes, Zaid will have to pay the zakah on his deposited capital amount. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
